quests.instruction: Mia's sweater leaves red marks around her wrists, and she can't lift her arms easily. What does this tell you about the sweater?
quests.correctAnswer: It is too tight 📏
quests.hint: Focus on what causes marks and stiff movement.
quests.explanation: Clothes that leave marks or make it hard to move are too small or too tight for the body.
quests.funFact: Tight clothes can rub the skin and make it hard to play.

quests.instruction: Omar's pants slip down every time he runs. What is the most likely problem?
quests.correctAnswer: They are too loose at the waist 👖
options: They are too short at the ankles 📏
They are too warm for running 🔥
They are too loose at the waist 👖
quests.hint: Think about what holds pants up.
quests.explanation: If pants are loose at the waist, they slide down when you move. A belt or a smaller size can help.
quests.funFact: Elastic or drawstring waists can be adjusted to fit.

quests.instruction: Which sign shows that a shirt fits well?
quests.correctAnswer: You can raise your arms and breathe easily 🙆
options: It leaves red lines on your skin 😖
It hangs down to your knees 📏
You can raise your arms and breathe easily 🙆
quests.explanation: A shirt that fits lets you reach, bend, and breathe without pulling or pinching.
quests.funFact: Clothes should feel comfortable without being baggy.

quests.instruction: Ravi's sleeves stop halfway up his forearms, and his wrists feel cold in the wind. What is the problem?
quests.correctAnswer: The sleeves are too short 💪
quests.hint: Look at where the sleeves end.
quests.explanation: Sleeves that don't reach the wrists leave skin exposed. That can happen when a child grows.
quests.funFact: Children can outgrow a coat's sleeves long before the body part of the coat feels small.

quests.instruction: Lina keeps stepping on the bottoms of her pants and trips. What is the problem?
quests.correctAnswer: The pants are too long 📏
quests.explanation: When pants are too long, the hems touch the floor and can catch under your feet.
quests.funFact: Pants that are a little long can be rolled or folded.

quests.instruction: What is a safe way to fix pants that are a little too long?
quests.correctAnswer: Fold or roll up the bottoms 👖
options: Fold or roll up the bottoms 👖
quests.explanation: Folding or rolling the hems shortens the legs without cutting and can be undone when you grow.
quests.funFact: Rolled-up pant legs are called cuffs.

quests.instruction: Why should clothes for playing outside let you move freely?
quests.correctAnswer: So you can run, bend, and climb safely 🏃
options: So you can run, bend, and climb safely 🏃
So they look neat on a hanger 👔
quests.hint: Remember what you do when you play.
quests.explanation: Clothes that allow movement let you play without pulling, stumbling, or feeling stuck.
quests.funFact: Sportswear often uses stretchy fabric for this reason.

quests.instruction: Kofi wants to test his new jacket. Which check best shows it lets him move?
quests.correctAnswer: Reach, bend, and squat with it on 🤸
options: Reach, bend, and squat with it on 🤸
Look at it in a mirror only 🪞
quests.hint: A good test uses the body.
quests.explanation: Moving your body in clothes shows if they pull, pinch, or ride up.
quests.funFact: Trying clothes on in the shop is better than guessing.

quests.instruction: A child sits at a desk all day. Which waistband is the most comfortable?
quests.correctAnswer: Soft elastic that doesn't dig in 👖
options: Soft elastic that doesn't dig in 👖
A stiff button waist that pinches 🔘
quests.explanation: Soft elastic gives and stretches when you sit, so it won't press on your stomach.
quests.funFact: Waistbands with elastic are used in many school clothes.

quests.instruction: Sana is trying on new shoes. How can she check the size?
quests.correctAnswer: Stand up and leave a thumb's width past her longest toe 👟
options: Stand up and leave a thumb's width past her longest toe 👟
Check that her toes press against the front 😖
Check that the shoes match her socks 🧦
quests.hint: Feet change shape when you stand.
quests.explanation: Standing spreads your feet. A little room at the front lets toes move comfortably and leaves space for growing.
quests.funFact: A thumb's width is a common guide when checking a child's shoe size.

quests.instruction: Why is it a good idea to try on shoes later in the day?
quests.correctAnswer: Feet can swell a little during the day 🦶
options: Feet can swell a little during the day 🦶
Shop prices drop in the evening 💰
quests.hint: Focus on what happens to feet after walking.
quests.explanation: Feet get slightly bigger as you move around, so trying shoes later helps you avoid buying a pair that's too small.
quests.funFact: Feet are not exactly the same size, so check both.

quests.instruction: Tomás's new shoes rub the back of his heel and it stings. What should he do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell a grown-up and try a better fit 🗣️
options: Tell a grown-up and try a better fit 🗣️
quests.hint: Ignoring a sore spot makes it worse.
quests.explanation: Rubbing can cause blisters, so telling an adult helps find a better fit or a way to protect the heel.
quests.funFact: Blisters form when skin rubs against something again and again.

quests.instruction: Priya's rain boots are two sizes too big. What is likely to happen when she walks?
quests.correctAnswer: Her feet slide and may get blisters 🥾
options: Her feet slide and may get blisters 🥾
quests.explanation: Extra space makes feet slip with each step, which causes rubbing and blisters.
quests.funFact: Boots with the right fit stay on better in mud.

quests.instruction: Ana's shoes still look fine, but her toes touch the front. What should she do?
quests.correctAnswer: Get the next size up 👟
quests.explanation: Toes pressing the front mean the shoes are too small, even if they look new.
quests.funFact: Children's feet can grow quickly, so check the fit often.

quests.instruction: Which footwear is best for a long walk on hot pavement?
quests.correctAnswer: Closed shoes with cushioned soles 👟
options: Bare feet to feel the ground 🦶
quests.explanation: Cushioned, closed shoes protect feet from hot ground and absorb the impact of walking.
quests.funFact: Pavement in direct sun can get much hotter than the air.

quests.instruction: The tag on a shirt says '6–7 years.' What does this help with?
quests.correctAnswer: Choosing a size likely to fit 📏
options: Choosing a size likely to fit 📏
quests.hint: It's about the body, not the fabric.
quests.explanation: Size labels are a rough guide to fit. Trying the clothes on still shows if they really fit.
quests.funFact: Different brands can fit differently even with the same size label.

quests.instruction: Mei's cousin gives her a jacket that's far too big. What is the best choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Wait until she grows into it 📈
options: Wait until she grows into it 📈
Wear it even if sleeves cover her hands 🧤
quests.explanation: A jacket that's much too big can get in the way. Saving it for later is a good use of a hand-me-down.
quests.funFact: Passing on clothes helps them get more use.

quests.instruction: Yuki tries on pants. Which test shows the waist is comfortable?
quests.correctAnswer: She can sit and bend without it pinching 🪑
options: She can sit and bend without it pinching 🪑
quests.explanation: Comfortable pants allow bending and sitting without digging in.
quests.funFact: Check the fit by sitting and bending, not only standing.

quests.instruction: Why should loose pant legs be tucked in or rolled up when riding a bike?
quests.correctAnswer: They can get caught in the chain ⚙️
options: They can get caught in the chain ⚙️
quests.explanation: Loose cloth can get caught in the chain and cause a fall.
quests.funFact: Bike riders use clips or bands to keep pant legs close.

quests.instruction: Zoe's sleeves are very long and flop over her hands while she draws. What could help?
quests.correctAnswer: Roll up the sleeves 💪
options: Wear gloves to hold the sleeves up 🧤
quests.hint: The sleeves are in the way.
quests.explanation: Rolling the sleeves back frees her hands and keeps the cloth from smudging the drawing.
quests.funFact: Many sleeves have cuffs that can be folded back.

quests.instruction: Sam's shirt keeps riding up when he reaches. What might help?
quests.correctAnswer: Tuck it in or choose a longer shirt 👕
options: Tuck it in or choose a longer shirt 👕
Wear a smaller size of shirt 📏
Take it off while he reaches 🚫
quests.explanation: A longer shirt or tucking it in keeps the middle covered while you reach.
quests.funFact: Many shirts are cut longer at the back than at the front.

quests.instruction: Why can boots that are too tight make feet colder, even with thick socks?
quests.correctAnswer: Tight boots squeeze out the warm air 🥾
options: Tight boots squeeze out the warm air 🥾
quests.explanation: When boots squeeze the socks flat, they trap less air and can slow blood flow, so feet feel colder.
quests.funFact: Boots for winter should have room for thick socks.

quests.instruction: Which sweater is warmer: one that has a little room, or one stretched very tight?
quests.correctAnswer: The one with a little room 🧶
options: The one with a little room 🧶
quests.explanation: A little space lets warm air collect between the sweater and your body, while tight sweaters squeeze that air out.
quests.funFact: A snug fit still works, but not so tight that it stretches.

quests.instruction: Aisha's gloves are too small, and her fingers feel tingly and cold. What should she do?
quests.correctAnswer: Try a bigger size 🧤
options: Keep them on and clench her fists 😖
quests.hint: Fingers need space for blood and warm air.
quests.explanation: Gloves that are too small press on the fingers and can make them colder. A bigger pair helps.
quests.funFact: Mittens are often warmer than gloves because fingers share warmth.

quests.instruction: Noor can't stand the seam across the toes of her socks. What might help?
quests.correctAnswer: Seamless socks, or wearing the socks inside out 🧦
options: Seamless socks, or wearing the socks inside out 🧦
Tighter shoes to hold the seam still 😖
quests.explanation: Seamless socks or flipped socks put the bumpy seam away from the toes.
quests.funFact: Some brands make socks with flat seams for sensitive feet.

quests.instruction: Mei finds tight collars uncomfortable at the neck. Which top might be more comfortable?
quests.correctAnswer: A top with a wide, soft neckline 👕
options: A shirt with a stiff collar 👔
A top with a wide, soft neckline 👕
quests.explanation: A wide neckline doesn't press on the neck, which feels better for some people.
quests.funFact: Everyone has different comfort needs.

quests.instruction: Why can the same clothing feel comfortable to one child and itchy to another?
quests.correctAnswer: People have different skin and preferences 🤝
options: Itchy clothes are always made badly 🧵
People have different skin and preferences 🤝
Comfort depends only on the color 🎨
quests.explanation: Skin sensitivity differs, so comfort differs. It's fine to tell a grown-up what feels uncomfortable.
quests.funFact: Soft tagless clothes are popular for sensitive skin.

quests.instruction: Ben's jacket sleeves reach past his fingertips. What is the problem?
quests.correctAnswer: The sleeves are too long 💪
quests.hint: Compare where the sleeves end with where his hands are.
quests.explanation: Sleeves that cover the hands can get in the way. Folding them back or a smaller size helps.
quests.funFact: Growing room is useful, but not too much.

quests.instruction: Which description shows a well-fitting shoe?
quests.correctAnswer: Room for toes to wiggle and no rubbing at the heel 👟
options: Room for toes to wiggle and no rubbing at the heel 👟
Toes pressed against the front with no room 😖
A heel that slides up and down with each step 🦶
quests.hint: Think about both space and snugness.
quests.explanation: A good fit has space for toes and holds the heel steady.
quests.funFact: Trying shoes on while wearing the socks you usually wear gives the most accurate fit.

quests.instruction: Mia has outgrown her coat. It is too short in the sleeves and tight across the shoulders. What should happen?
quests.correctAnswer: Pass it on and get a bigger size 📈
options: Pass it on and get a bigger size 📈
quests.hint: Clothes are for the body you have now.
quests.explanation: Tight shoulders and short sleeves mean the coat no longer fits. Passing it on lets someone else use it.
quests.funFact: Clothes swaps and hand-me-downs give coats a second life.
